title: ASC 350-60 Crypto Asset Accounting - DemoCo Q2 2026
conclusionSummary: BTC and ETH are in scope of ASC 350-60 and measured at fair value; the self-issued WDEMO token is out of scope. The Q2 roll-forward ties from 1,850,000 USD to 1,550,000 USD and both holdings are significant for disclosure.
